policy.rankMeaning: research priority by authority and fit; NOT an empirically measured accuracy score

sourceDefinitions.priority1: official documents and dated primary match protocols for factual dispute resolution
sourceDefinitions.priority2: free structured historical result candidates; require record-level verification before use
sourceDefinitions.priority3: free API/current-event or secondary historical corroboration candidates with conditions
sourceDefinitions.priority4: supplementary, rights-limited or demonstrated-error reference only

sources.title: RPL competition documents and match protocols
sources.qualityEvidence: Primary-source formal match decisions; site footer reviewed 2026-10-20 (explicit ban on automated extraction). No licensed API, no empirically measured result error rate.
sources.limitations: The RPL official website expressly prohibits automated extraction of site information by any services without RPL's official permission; manual citation/checking of dated official results only. This primary-source authority is NOT an ingestion or ML license; no automatic browsing, scraping or headless browser harvesting.

sources.title: Dated official football club match reports
sources.limitations: An individual club report corroborates a match, not a complete licensed season or independent feed.

sources.title: OpenFootball Europe RPL TXT
sources.qualityEvidence: Published CC0 2024/25 RPL file pinned at commit 63df627f3c87ce71708f016522ea236cf74332c3. Independent published-source comparison in PR #103 / GitHub Actions 39785193625: 240/240 directed fixtures agree with Footbolno by date, clubs and final score. Five source seasons structurally parsed; historical anomalies in other years remain. This is NOT 240 original RPL protocol verifications or upstream independence.
sources.limitations: Five discontinuous historical seasons; 2019/20 has four and 2020/21 two [awarded] results (administrative goals, not observed play). 2023/24 reverses one Sochi-Spartak home venue. Even 2024/25 240/240 cross-publisher agreement cannot establish pre-match as-of history, original source independence or model-training rights.

sources.title: Footbolno Russian football open data
sources.qualityEvidence: 2026-10-22 one-shot zero-cost published CC BY 4.0 CSV research: 2024/25 240/240 directed fixtures, dates and scores agreed with pinned CC0 OpenFootball (PR #103, run 39785193625); 2025/26 240/240 directed score records agreed with pinned CC BY-SA Wikimedia revision 1359156694 (PR #104, run 39786974477); 2026/27 16/16 matches on Oct 17-19 and 23-25 agreed with anonymous league-filtered SportScore REST v1 (PR #107, run 39816513768). Current source snapshot 240 fixtures with 88 finished/152 scheduled on Oct 22. None is an original official-protocol audit.
sources.limitations: 2016/17-2020/21 source snapshots quarantined for missing, extra or duplicated directed fixtures (2020/21 36 duplicate pairs). Current 2026/27 240 count is one observed publisher snapshot, NOT verified live season coverage or pre-kickoff timestamps. Published CC BY 4.0 publisher claim and limited manually/one-shot corroborated match records do not authenticate ESPN/other upstream license chain, original legal title, official match protocols or independent archival as-of. No provider import or training; browser-only opt-in and bounded research use with attribution.

sources.title: SportScore public REST widgets
sources.qualityEvidence: Empirical 2026-10-22 bounded published REST v1 research: one uniquely verified Russian Premier League competition search result, six anonymous filtered HTTP-200 one-day queries, 16/16 directed pair matches against Footbolno for Oct 17-19 and Oct 23-25, 0 completed-score disagreements for 8 finished games, no page caps or unmapped events. Machine-checked numeric-only evidence: docs/M0_SPORTSCORE_FILTERED_RPL_EVIDENCE.json; GitHub Actions 39816513768. This proves short-window RPL API presence, NOT full season, original source independence or training rights. API-specific attributed free terms and restrictive general site terms have unresolved precedence.
sources.limitations: One-off anonymous REST v1 competition filter demonstrably covers the 16-match researched window; worldwide unfiltered daily endpoint otherwise clipped at 200 records. No verified 2024/25 training or 2025/26 complete historical free REST coverage, verified pre-kickoff revision history or licensed season-long automated extraction. API/widget-specific free attributed use and general terms conflict for bulk/ML persistence and require written clarification; no inference that free access grants model-training, backup, commercial predictions or original RPL database rights. Visible Powered by SportScore dofollow link is mandatory where authorized source data is displayed. Public widget documentation has no season selector and no free complete historical season pagination. There is no paid fallback, no production adapters or automated collection.

sources.title: Wikipedia revision-pinned club and RPL articles
sources.qualityEvidence: English Wikipedia CC BY-SA 4.0 revision 1359156694 result matrix: 2025/26 240/240 directed score cells match Footbolno public CSV in PR #104 / GitHub Actions 39786974477. The table has NO per-match kickoff dates; it may reproduce the same original RPL data. 2026/27 English/Russian article statistics dated 2026-08-09 and unsuitable as an October current-season calendar.
sources.limitations: English Wikipedia CC BY-SA 4.0 attribution/ShareAlike applies to published article content; match-fact/database upstream title and downstream ML/derived forecast rights require independent analysis. The pinned 2025/26 matrix lacks kickoff times and prior-publication snapshots, and 2026/27 page is stale; matching scores do not authenticate official protocols or data independence. One bounded historical revision fetch was performed for research, not recurring bulk extraction, source-data retention, training or republication.

sources.title: Open Matchday public 2026-27 RPL football results directory
sources.qualityEvidence: Pinned 2026-10-20 open-matchday master 0e39da91... RPL CSV source reports 87 finished games and 242 goals; 109 scheduled: 44 fewer combined match/fixture rows than Footbolno's 240; source label soccerway only. No empirical match-level precision.
sources.limitations: Repository disclaimer restricts data to informational noncommercial use and leaves Soccerway upstream rights with publisher. RPL results 87/242 goals vs Footbolno 88/246 and 109 fixtures vs 152. Derived from same type of upstream editorial feed, not independently authenticated. No automated Soccerway scraping, provider importing, commercial reuse, ML training or source redistribution approved.

sources.title: SStats.net documented free football API
sources.qualityEvidence: 2026-10-20 manual terms/docs review only: public API docs state no-key requests capped at 30/min per IP and 300/min globally; some endpoints integrate Flashscore; no RPL fixture-accuracy or free historical entitlement check.
sources.limitations: Free HTTP access is not a license for storing, copying or training on upstream Flashscore/other provider data. Producer explicitly describes Flashscore integration and offers /Ls/* endpoints; identity of upstream rights holders, exact Russian Premier League 2024/25-2026/27 coverage, as-of publication times, ML and derivative public output permissions all unverified. No endpoint calls, stored rows, registration or adapter allowed in M0.

sources.title: UEFA published national Russian Premier League match calendar
sources.qualityEvidence: 2026-10-21 UEFA.com National Associations Russia domestic 2026/27 lists dated league matchdays; this is a republished schedule, not original signed RPL/RFU protocols, no measured error rate, verified match statuses, independent source chain or historical publication snapshots.
sources.limitations: UEFA General Terms §6.2 limit website Content to private noncommercial viewing and explicitly prohibit systematic gathering/compilation into a database. Manually inspect and cite limited official context only; NO automated polling, bulk extraction, live source, proprietary data reuse or training. Do not count UEFA republishing a Russian domestic source as an independent original match protocol.
